title: kbmon gives no silence measure to a session with no transcript or no session id, and calls a session that fans out to subagents silent
goal: kbmon's sessions panel gives a live session with no transcript found, or with no session id, a silent_s (from its process or its newest known activity) instead of none, so it counts in the metric and its line; silent_s reads the newest write of the session's transcript and of its subagent transcripts, so a session that fans out is not reported silent; kb/_self/monitoring.md counts the alert rules otel/kbmon.rules.yml holds. Found by the SP-hxxn6fnv review (two S2 gaps and one S3 on ST-xvdk32ag)

run:
import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, uuid
if os.name == "nt":
    print("check skipped: a fake claude process needs a POSIX host"); sys.exit(0)
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); C = os.path.join(T, "cfg"); S = os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite")
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
env.update(CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C, COLUMNS="200", KB_COORD_STORE=S, NO_COLOR="1")
def sh(*a, cwd=T, inp=None):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300, input=inp)
K = os.path.join(T, "clone"); os.makedirs(K)
sh("git", "init", "-q", ".", cwd=K)
sh("git", "-c", "user.email=a@example.com", "-c", "user.name=n", "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "i", cwd=K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json"), K); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "bin")); FAKE = os.path.join(T, "bin", "claude"); os.symlink("/bin/sleep", FAKE)
procs = []
def transcript(base, sid, text, age=0):
    pdir = os.path.join(C, "projects", "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "-" for c in base)); os.makedirs(pdir, exist_ok=True)
    p = os.path.join(pdir, sid + ".jsonl")
    with open(p, "w") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"type": "user", "cwd": base, "sessionId": sid, "timestamp": "2026-10-26T10:00:00Z",
                            "message": {"role": "user", "content": text}}) + "\n")
    if age:
        t = time.time() - age; os.utime(p, (t, t))
def session(base, text, age=0):
    sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(base, "_cache", "coord_hook"), exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(base, "_cache", "coord_hook", sid + ".json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump({"items": [], "lease_until": time.time() + 600, "token": "t"}, f)
    sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, "claim", "session/" + sid, "--ttl", "600", "--holder", "h")
    transcript(base, sid, text, age)
    procs.append(subprocess.Popen([FAKE, "120"], cwd=base))
    return sid, procs[-1].pid
def kbmon(*a):
    return sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbmon.py"), "--root", K, *a)
def hook(ev):
    return sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, ".claude", "hooks", "coord_hook.py"), cwd=ev.get("cwd", K), inp=json.dumps(ev))
def done():
    for p in procs: p.kill(); p.wait()
    for l in subprocess.run(["ps", "-axo", "pid=,command="], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines():
        q, _, c = l.strip().partition(" ")
        if c.startswith(FAKE):
            try: os.kill(int(q), 9)
            except (OSError, ValueError): pass

import re
try:
    sa, pa = session(K, "planted-quiet", age=900)                    # A: silent 15 min
    W = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "agent-ST-zzfresha")
    sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-zzfresha", W, cwd=K)
    # B: transcript older than main, but a subagent file written just now
    sb, pb = session(W, "planted-sub", age=4000)
    pdir = os.path.join(C, "projects", "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "-" for c in W))
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(pdir, sb, "subagents"), exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(pdir, sb, "subagents", "agent-1.jsonl"), "w").write("{}\n")
    W2 = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "agent-ST-zzfuture")
    sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-zzfuture", W2, cwd=K)
    # C: future mtime
    sc, pc = session(W2, "planted-future", age=-5000)
    # D: bound, transcript deleted
    W3 = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "agent-ST-zznotr")
    sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-zznotr", W3, cwd=K)
    sd, pd = session(W3, "planted-notr")
    os.remove(os.path.join(C, "projects", "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "-" for c in W3), sd + ".jsonl"))
    # E: unbound
    W4 = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "agent-ST-zzunb")
    sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-zzunb", W4, cwd=K)
    pe = subprocess.Popen([FAKE, "120"], cwd=W4); procs.append(pe)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    j = kbmon("--json", "--panel", "sessions"); m = kbmon("--metrics", "--panel", "sessions"); o = kbmon("--once", "--panel", "sessions")
finally:
    done()
rows = json.loads(j.stdout)["panels"]["sessions"]["data"].get("sessions") or []
by={r["pid"]:r for r in rows}
r={"a session with no transcript has a silent_s":by.get(pd,{}).get("silent_s") is not None,"an unbound live claude process has a silent_s":by.get(pe.pid,{}).get("silent_s") is not None,"a session whose subagent file was just written is not silent":(by.get(pb,{}).get("silent_s") is not None and by[pb]["silent_s"]<600)}
print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r.values()) else 1)

options: the newer of the newest spool row and the process start
